ui.the_period_selects_recipients_whose_firs: The period selects recipients whose first recorded email send falls within that period. Each count includes each recipient once per campaign, even after repeated interactions. Opens include clicks and submissions; clicks include submissions. These are cumulative recipient counts, not additional recorded events. Percentages divide these counts by emails sent. Changes compare totals with the preceding equal-length period (7, 30 or 365 days), counting each period's observations up to its own end. An increase is more recipients, not a percentage change. All time has no preceding period to compare. A dash means no emails were sent for a percentage to be calculated.
